professionalDescription: I sell as part of my professional activity.
privateDescription: I sell in a personal capacity, outside any professional activity.
sectionIntro: We verify your SIREN and SIRET with INSEE. Setting up payments with Stripe remains a separate step.
success: SIREN and SIRET verified with INSEE.
notFound: No result matches this SIREN or SIRET. Check the numbers entered.
mismatch: This SIRET does not belong to the business identified by the SIREN.
unavailable: INSEE verification is temporarily unavailable. Your information has not been rejected; try again later.
partialData: Some information is not available from INSEE. Supporting documents or manual review may be required.
sameAddress: My personal and professional addresses are the same.
addressQuestion: Would you like to display your full professional address on your store?
showAddress: Yes, display my full professional address.
addressHelper: This choice affects the public display of your store. Legally required information may remain available in the seller’s legal information and during the transaction, as required by applicable obligations.
sameVerifiedBusiness: This store belongs to the same business that has already been verified.
anotherEstablishment: Declare another establishment of this business.
dashboardPending: Your business verification is pending. You can sell once the required checks are complete.
